description: Collecting voice samples for a person: who may collect, add, hear and delete (ADR-0071, ADR-0075).
precondition: Active person with Voice ID consent; collector holds the Thu giọng mẫu hộ capability.

preconditions: Collector holds the Thu giọng mẫu hộ capability.
Person is active and consented to notice "1.4" or later, with 2 collected samples.
Audio holds 20 seconds of one clear voice.
cases.inputs: actorId: the collector; userId: the person recorded; audio: a clear voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg; personAgreed: true.
cases.return: Success with the collected sample (MSG473 "Đã lưu giọng mẫu thu hộ."); the sample belongs to the person recorded, with the collector on it and no meeting.
cases.log: Saved: encrypted sample with its recording; notification to the person; audit row records the collection with the proxy scope.
cases.note: UC-86b · BR-452 · BR-453 · MSG473 · Deviation: no meeting scope since ADR-0075

preconditions: The person has no active consent, or consented only to a notice before 1.4.
cases.inputs: actorId: the collector; userId: the person recorded; audio: a voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg; personAgreed: true.
cases.return: Failure NoConsent (MSG475 "Người này chưa đồng ý dùng Voice ID theo điều khoản mới. Họ bật ở trang Giọng nói của tôi."); the audio never goes to the worker.

preconditions: The person already has 50 proxy samples.
cases.inputs: actorId: the collector; userId: the person recorded; audio: a voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg; personAgreed: true.
cases.return: Failure LimitReached (MSG476 "Đã đủ 50 giọng mẫu thu hộ cho người này. Xoá bớt rồi thu lại."); nothing is kept.
cases.note: UC-86b · BR-448 · MSG476 · Deviation: limit is 50 per person, 5 per collector is gone (ADR-0075)

preconditions: The person consented to notice "1.4" or later.
The collector did not confirm the person agreed to this take.
cases.inputs: actorId: the collector; userId: the person recorded; audio: a voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg; personAgreed: false.
cases.return: Failure NotConfirmed (MSG483 "Hãy hỏi ý người được thu và xác nhận họ đồng ý cho lần thu này trước khi lưu giọng mẫu."); the audio never goes to the worker and nothing is kept.

preconditions: The person consented to notice "1.4" or later.
cases.inputs: actorId: the collector; userId: the person recorded; audio: a 3-second recording; contentType: audio/mpeg; personAgreed: true.
cases.return: Failure Rejected (MSG309); errors[file] = ["Giọng mẫu quá ngắn — cần ít nhất 6 giây có tiếng nói. Hãy đọc hết đoạn văn mẫu."]; nothing is kept.

preconditions: The person consented to notice "1.4" or later.
cases.inputs: actorId: the collector; userId: the person recorded; audio: a clear voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg; personAgreed: true.
cases.return: Failure EngineUnavailable (MSG312 "Máy chủ nhận dạng giọng nói chưa sẵn sàng. Vui lòng thử lại sau."); nothing is kept.
cases.log: Warning logged with the person id.
